children: Solaris announced an intended private offering of $1.0 billion of Senior Notes due 2032 to fund growth capital expenditures and general corporate purposes.
Issuer (subsidiary) intends to offer $1.0B aggregate principal of Senior Notes due 2032 in a Rule 144A / Reg S private placement.
Net proceeds expected to be used for general corporate purposes, growth capital expenditures and fees and expenses related to the offering.
Notes will be senior unsecured, guaranteed by Solaris and certain subsidiaries and will not be registered under the Securities Act.
Company furnished a preliminary offering memorandum (Sept 22, 2026) and issued a press release announcing the offering.
Proceeds intended to align capital structure with contracted cash flows amid large planned capex and fleet expansion initiatives.
